title: Note list of an audio clip, the clip field `audio_noten` (notes.md, note editor spec N3): the id of the curve the notes were cut from and the notes
description: Rules that compare values of the instance cannot be written in JSON Schema and are checked by notes_contract.ts (audioNotenPruefung) and the core: ids are unique; the list is ordered by qa and qe[i] <= qa[i+1] (touching notes are allowed); qe > qa + 0.01; ton differs from qton and lies within qton +-24, with 1e-4 of tolerance because targets are rounded to 1e-4 (24 itself is inside); a differs from qa and e from qe; the effective end (e, else qe) is greater than the effective start (a, else qa). Stored form is canonical: a target that equals its detected value (or the default 1, 1, 0, 0) is absent.

kurve_id.description: Curve id: <detector version>.<segmenter version>, for example pyin-1.noten_hmm-1; the same string as the middle part of the sidecar name

note.description: qa, qe, a, e are source seconds; qton and ton are float MIDI pitch (A4 = 69); p is the level 0..1; vib and drift are factors (1 = unchanged); formant is in semitones; gain_db in dB
